title: USD-M receive-funding carry conditioned only on lagged open-interest acceleration

distinctness.S1M: S-1M scores funding acceleration; S-1W never scores funding.
distinctness.S1O: S-1O is BTC-only OI growth plus funding-sign persistence at settlement events; S-1W is a broad fixed-clock cohort, uses OI second difference, and has no funding threshold or streak.
distinctness.S1J: S-1J has a Spot hedge; S-1W is USD-M perpetual-only.
distinctness.S1D_S1N_S1V: Those families rank or transition funding dispersion; S-1W never ranks funding.
distinctness.S1Q_S1R_S1S: Those families use sign transition, surprise, or settlement timing; S-1W decisions are fixed and funding-blind until side assignment.
distinctness.momentumFamilies: S-1W has no price, return, volume, basis, premium, or OI-value input in selection.

requiredBeforeAnyOutcomeArchiveOpen: official mapping of archive create_time to the REST period-end timestamp
historical publication or availability time for every selected OI row
evidence that the acquired historical row revision was observable before the decision
historical point-in-time availability of the funding sign used for side assignment

signalAndCohort.asOfRule: latest actual create_time <= decision_time - 30 minutes; age from each requested cutoff <= 10 minutes; no grid snapping; actual irregular timestamps retained
signalAndCohort.eligible: acceleration strictly greater than the frozen trial threshold
signalAndCohort.membership: all eligible 11-symbol fixed-universe members after BTCUSDT quarantine; no cross-sectional funding rank; no symbol replacement
signalAndCohort.side: latest settled funding strictly before decision: positive => short, negative => long, zero or unknown => that symbol allocation remains cash
signalAndCohort.activation: at least 3 OI-selected symbols with known prior funding sign and complete required evidence; otherwise the entire daily cohort remains cash
signalAndCohort.allocation: original USD 1000 divided equally across all OI-selected symbols; a no-side symbol remains cash and its amount is not reallocated; an active leg is capped at one third of original capital
signalAndCohort.missingSelectedLeg: any missing or invalid selected-leg signal, sign, price, funding, or capacity evidence invalidates the cohort and complete partition; never replace a symbol or silently convert a missing selected leg to cash
signalAndCohort.entry: first contract 1h open at 03:00 UTC after the 02:00 decision
signalAndCohort.exit: same fixed quantity at 03:00 UTC after the frozen holding days

economics.fundingEvents: actual archived events with entry < funding_time < exit; entry and exit boundaries are excluded; archived funding_interval_hours retained
economics.pairedNoFundingBenchmark: same cohort, sides, quantities, timestamps, prices, and costs with funding cash set to zero
economics.unconditionedSignOnlyComparator: same fixed clock, sign-side rule, holding period, costs, and complete calendar across all 11 eligible symbols without the OI acceleration filter; reported separately and never used to select an S-1W trial
economics.cashComparator: unremunerated USD 1000 cash path with zero nominal return on the complete daily calendar; actual account cash yield remains UNKNOWN
economics.settlementMark: latest complete mark-price 1h close at or before actual funding timestamp; disclosed proxy

statistics.unit: synchronized complete daily portfolio cohort including cash
statistics.intervals: two-sided 95 percent and one-sided 95 percent lower bounds for total net, carry-only net, and paired incremental net versus the unconditioned sign-only comparator under every cost scenario
statistics.multiplicity: one-sided Holm step-down across all 12 frozen trial daily series; primary must pass; cross-family adjusted evidence remains NON_AUTHORITATIVE_NOT_REGISTERED
statistics.whiteRealityCheck: centered synchronized maximum across all 12 trials

pbo.selection: six-block in-sample highest stress carry-only daily mean then stress total daily mean then trial id
pbo.lossEvent: selected trial ranks in the out-of-sample bottom half

statistics.holdout: opened once only if the fixed primary passes every development gate; no diagnostic selects or replaces it

riskAndCapacity.drawdown: daily marked portfolio equity from original USD 1000, with incurred costs and funding; null when source gate fails
riskAndCapacity.publicCapacityProxy: after cohort seal only: 0.0001 * min(previous complete UTC-day contract quote volume, median preceding seven complete UTC days) per selected symbol
riskAndCapacity.perLegCapacityLaw: every active selected leg public proxy must cover its frozen allocated USD notional; aggregate capacity cannot rescue a failing leg

verdictLaw.UNMEASURED: causal source, checksum, schema, custody, fixed schedule, or complete economic evidence is invalid or unavailable; numeric outcomes remain null
verdictLaw.NO_GO: valid complete measurement fails any frozen economic, interval, multiplicity, drawdown, concentration, fee, or capacity gate
verdictLaw.GO: requires every development and holdout gate plus verified account-effective fees and executable capacity
verdictLaw.publicOnlyPositiveProxy: cannot exceed capital NO_GO while account-effective fees or executable capacity are UNKNOWN

claimBoundary: predictive archive association only; no instrument, randomization, or causal-mechanism claim
